Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for compounds linked to document CHEMBL1240317. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL1240317. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
